token.description: Cloudflare Tunnel token (from Zero Trust dashboard)

health_url.description: Optional URL to check tunnel health

start_command.description:
Command template to start the tunnel. Use {port} and {host} placeholders.
Example: "bore local {port} --to bore.pub"

url_pattern.description: Optional regex to extract public URL from command stdout

OpenVpnTunnelConfig.description:
OpenVPN tunnel configuration (`[tunnel.openvpn]`).

Required when `tunnel.tunnel_provider = "openvpn"`. Omitting this section entirely
preserves previous behavior. Setting `tunnel.tunnel_provider = "none"` (or removing
the `[tunnel.openvpn]` block) cleanly reverts to no-tunnel mode.

Defaults: `connect_timeout_secs = 30`.

advertise_address.description:
Advertised address once VPN is connected (e.g., `"10.8.0.2:42617"`).
When omitted the tunnel falls back to `http://{local_host}:{local_port}`.

auth_file.description: Optional path to auth credentials file (`--auth-user-pass`).

config_file.description: Path to `.ovpn` configuration file (must not be empty).

connect_timeout_secs.description: Connection timeout in seconds (default: 30, must be > 0).

extra_args.description: Extra openvpn CLI arguments forwarded verbatim.

region.description: Server region: `"us"` (USA), `"eu"` (Europe), `"ap"` (Asia), `"br"` (South America), `"au"` (Australia), or omit for auto.

token.description: Pinggy access token (optional — free tier works without one).

funnel.description: Use Tailscale Funnel (public internet) vs Serve (tailnet only)

TunnelConfig.description:
Tunnel configuration for exposing the gateway publicly (`[tunnel]` section).

Supported model_providers: `"none"` (default), `"cloudflare"`, `"tailscale"`, `"ngrok"`, `"openvpn"`, `"pinggy"`, `"custom"`.

tunnel_provider.description: How the gateway gets exposed to the public internet so webhooks (Telegram, Slack, etc.) can reach it. `none` = keep it local, no tunnel; `cloudflare` = Cloudflare Tunnel via cloudflared (needs a Zero Trust account and token); `tailscale` = Tailscale Funnel/Serve (tailnet-only or public, no account beyond tailscale); `ngrok` = ngrok agent with auth token; `openvpn` = bring-your-own OpenVPN egress; `pinggy` = Pinggy SSH tunnels (quick one-shot URLs); `custom` = run an arbitrary command you define under `[tunnel.custom]`.

description: Tunnel configuration for exposing the gateway publicly (`[tunnel]`).
